name: Brave Soul
source:
It is a world very different from ours, a world in which magic exists, a world where peasants labor under the burden of heavy taxes imposed upon them by the unfair rulers of the land. Although the commoners have a difficult lot, there are those among them with the strength to use his sword and make a name for himself -- an adventurer. To be an adventurer is the dream of every peasant.

The story details the journey of a young man who was raised in the countryside of Souvania, on the continent of Valencia. Disowned by his own father and forced to make his way in life, he chooses to become a Hunter, a mercenary who accepts jobs for a variety of adventures. Heading into town to officially join the Hunter’s Guild with his dragon Shell at his side, he happens across a mysterious girl who looks strikingly like the Moon Goddess.

The Moon Goddess... Ever since he was young, a beautiful girl appears before him on nights of a full moon. Because of the mysterious manner of her appearance, he gave her a unique name. With the mysterious girl Alicia and dragon Shell at his side, as well as new characters he will join with later, our hero embarks on many bold adventures. But will he ever be able to solve the bizarre mystery of the beautiful Moon Goddess standing in the lake...?

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20140908054726/http://www.peachprincess.com/brave-soul-1680.html]Peach Princess[/url]]
translation:
这是一个与我们的世界截然不同的地方：魔法真实存在，平民百姓在不公的统治者所征重税之下艰难度日。然而，其中也有人凭借手中长剑闯出名声，他们便是冒险者。成为冒险者，是每个平民的梦想。

故事讲述一名年轻人的旅程。他在巴伦西亚大陆的苏瓦尼亚乡间长大，被亲生父亲逐出家门后，只得独自谋生，于是选择成为“猎人”——接受各类冒险委托的佣兵。他带着小龙谢尔进城，准备正式加入猎人公会，却偶然遇见一名容貌酷似月之女神的神秘少女。

月之女神……从他年幼时起，每逢满月之夜，都会有一名美丽少女出现在他面前。由于她现身的方式充满谜团，他给她取了一个特别的称呼。此后，主人公与神秘少女艾丽西亚、小龙谢尔以及后来结识的伙伴们一同踏上了接连不断的大胆冒险。然而，他最终能否解开伫立湖中的美丽月之女神所隐藏的奇异谜团……？

[摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20140908054726/http://www.peachprincess.com/brave-soul-1680.html]Peach Princess[/url]]
